description.fun: A robot Delibird that fires huge blasts of ice from the round device it carries, propelling itself across snowy lands. Its extendable head may be modelled on a jack-in-the-box, and only two sightings have ever been reported. Its Ice and Water typing may nod to Delibird's prototype in a 1997 demo of Pokémon Gold and Silver, which was also Water and Ice.
description.guide: An Ice and Water-type Paradox Pokémon found in Pokémon Violet, said to be either a future relative of Delibird or a version of it from a parallel timeline. It propels itself by firing blasts of ice from the device it carries.
description.tagline: A robot Delibird that jets across the snow on blasts of ice
